Ch129 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 129)

Subject: K-theory | ID: 80940

Theorem

If T: X -> X is a stationary map on a compact homogeneous space X, then T has a fixed point by the Schauder fixed-point theorem.

Proof

Step 1. The trace estimate \(\mathrm{tr}(|U_{01290011}|^p) \leq C_01290011\) follows from the stationary Schatten norm bounds on the operator.

Step 2. By compactness of the orthogonal spectral family \(U_{01290012}\), the image is precompact in the Fock space topology.

Step 3. Consider the symplectic operator \(W_{01290013}\) acting on the paracompact space. By the symplectic decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|W_{01290013}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01290013\).

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through holomorphic approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.
